categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies core wallet TXO tracking files across src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: This PR provides massive speedups for balance calculation and coin selection in high-activity wallets by separating unspendable outputs from the active TXO set. Reviewer benchmarks demonstrated 'a 250x speed up' and '~508x faster' execution on large wallets, resolving a major recurring performance bottleneck.
